newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Icatu Hartford to launch new insurance.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Icatu Hartford to launch new insurance.

text.p: Brazilian pension and life insurance company Icatu Hartford Seguros said it planned to launch mass market insurance products to target groups in Brazil in the first half of 1997.
The company was negotiating to launch its first offers with a Brazilian supermarket chain and a local newspaper, said Victor Maia, Icatu Hartford's sales director.
"We will be the first insurer to launch this product in Brazil. The potential of this kind of market is huge," he said.
Formed five years ago, Icatu Hartford is a joint-venture between Brazilian banking group Icatu and U.S. insurer ITT Hartford Group Inc.
The new product, which can include life insurance and personal injury cover, will be used by firms to increase sales and guarantee client fidelity, he added.
Maia said he expects Icatu Hartford's premiums to reach 300 million reais in 1997, a rise of 30 percent over last year.
